comparison.objective: Tune and lock a robot-axis shock absorber vs unplug and stow an EV connector and close its door.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key alignment, collar rotation and bounded tightening vs latch-button depression, loaded extraction, cable handling and holster insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe carriage cycles with no hard-stop strike or drift vs no high-force yank/drop, connector holstered and door shut.
comparison.reason: A generic release/secure sequence does not make the latch-extraction task equivalent to iterative damping calibration. Missing rubric detail: connector button force is explicitly provisional, but this does not create plausible overlap.
